author: Huawei
description:
Did you know? In the mountains of Guangxi lives the "Stone Mountain Elf" — the white-headed langur. With only around 1,400 left globally, they're even rarer than giant pandas.

Once difficult to track, these elusive primates can now be monitored and studied with AI-powered systems, developed in collaboration with a local nature reserve. The technology enables more efficient and less intrusive conservation efforts for all.

As of March, over 37,200 sightings have been recorded, turning data into real protection for wildlife in an intelligent and caring way! That's #TECHcares in action. #Tech4Nature #EnvironmentProtection #Huawei
title: Protecting Stone Mountain Elves with AI
